properties.name: Bhushi Dam & Waterfall Catchment
properties.name_mr: भुशी धरण व धबधबा पाणलोट क्षेत्र
properties.guidance: High upstream rainfall in Tiger Hill catchment elevates sudden water surge danger. Do not step onto overflow masonry or waterfall plunge areas.
properties.upstream_info: Fed by 4.8 km² steep catchment from Tiger Valley. Water level telemetry is modelled from radar & rain gauge proxies.

properties.name: Kune Falls & Valley Escarpment
properties.guidance: Three-tiered 200m waterfall over basalt cliff. Wet spray causes slippery edges and minor pebble roll off cut slopes.
properties.upstream_info: Water-level telemetry unavailable. Risk estimated from IMD radar & regional precipitation.

properties.name: Tiger's Leap (Waghai) Escarpment
properties.guidance: Severe 650m sheer cliff drop. Dense fog and strong monsoon updrafts reduce visibility. Stay strictly behind railing.
properties.upstream_info: High windshear zone, rapid surface runoff drains into Konkan plains.

properties.name: Lion's Point
properties.guidance: Exposed ridge between Lonavala and Aamby Valley road. Minor surface erosion observed on unpaved shoulders.
properties.upstream_info: Surface sheet wash during intense showers.

properties.name: Rajmachi Trek & Udhewadi Route
properties.guidance: 15km kutcha jungle road severely waterlogged. Four mountain seasonal stream crossings are in spate. Do not attempt on two-wheelers or without local guides.
properties.upstream_info: No cellular telemetry. Satellite precipitation indicates over 160mm in 24 hours.

properties.name: Amrutanjan Bridge / Bhor Ghat Expressway
properties.guidance: Steep cut slopes stabilized with wire netting experiencing heavy saturation. Watch for loose boulders rolling onto Pune-bound corridor.
properties.upstream_info: Continuous road safety sensor active. Overburden saturation 86%.

properties.name: Adoshi Tunnel Vicinity
properties.guidance: Approach to tunnel portal. Drainage culverts flowing at 70% capacity. Surface aquaplaning risk during sudden downpours.
properties.upstream_info: Separate collision/incident risk monitored independently from natural hazards.

properties.name: Monkey Hill Railway Ghat Corridor
properties.guidance: Central Railway ghat section. Historical boulder drop spot. Catch-water drains monitored; bank patrols deployed with detonators.
properties.upstream_info: Geotechnical fence sensor indicates minor tension cracks on upper terrace.

properties.name: Thakurwadi Railway Catchment
properties.guidance: Ghat brake-testing station. Water overflow from mountain culverts into ballast. Operational caution.
properties.upstream_info: Catchment runoff drains towards Karjat plains.

properties.name: Patan Village & Hillside Settlements
properties.name_mr: पाटण गाव व डोंगर पायथा वस्त्या
properties.guidance: Upper slope exhibits weathered soil mantle with high antecedent saturation. Residents near eastern escarpment advised to remain alert for ground fissures.
properties.upstream_info: Terrain slope 29°, soil moisture 84%. Nearest shelter at Bhangarwadi.

properties.name: Valvan Dam & Indrayani Headwaters
properties.guidance: Reservoir water storage at 78% capacity. Controlled spillway release not currently required. Downstream riverbed clear.
properties.upstream_info: Hydropower catchment for Khopoli generating station.

properties.name: Lonavala Civic Center (Ryewood)
properties.guidance: Flat urban plateau with good drainage. Municipal stormwater drains operating normally. Safe zone for emergency staging.

properties.name: Mumbai-Pune Yashwantrao Chavan Expressway
properties.segment: Bhor Ghat Section (Amrutanjan Bridge to Khopoli Exit)
properties.traffic_notes: All 6 lanes open. Catch-net monitoring crews active at km 41-44.

properties.name: Old Mumbai-Pune Highway (NH 48)
properties.traffic_notes: Open for two-wheelers and local transport. Surface wet.

properties.name: Central Railway Mumbai-Pune Line
properties.segment: Monkey Hill to Thakurwadi Triple Ghat Line
properties.traffic_notes: Catch-pits cleaned. Hill gangs equipped with walkie-talkies.
